lessons.title: Bodyweight Warm Up
lessons.notes:
NOTES:

For this warm up you may follow along, or go at your own pace and perform as many repetitions in each movement based on your body’s needs today.

Bodyweight Warm Up

Marching in Place*

Rise and Falls

Knee Circles

Hip Flexion-Extension

Leg Swings

Pelvic Rocks

Pelvic Circles

Spinal Roll Downs

Side Wipes

Translations

Side Bend with Reaching

Pummel Series*

Neck Figure 8’s*

Wrist Shakes

Body Drops

Suggested repetitions are between 8-30 on each movement

Marching in Place

Marching in Place can be substituted with any form of light cardio movement you’d like - a brisk walk outdoors, a rower, bike, etc.

Pummel Series:

If you experience challenges with the elbow circles, allow your thumb to separate from your body as needed to create smooth movements.

Neck Figure 8’s:

At any time if you feel dizzy when looking up, stop and/or skip this exercises. You can explore keeping your eyes focused forward and see if that’s makes a difference.

lessons.title: Starter Workout
lessons.notes:
NOTES:

Since the primary goal of this On Ramp Phase is more so to focus on learning the essential components that will support your health and movement training moving forward, the included Starter Workout is optional. If your schedule allows and you choose to perform this Workout, 1-3x during your 7 day On Ramp Phase is suggested.

If you choose to skip the workout, move directly on to your stretches in the next section.

lessons.title: Stretching

NOTES:

Recommendation:

1. Hip Flexor
